title: GraderResult
description: The single output contract every grader returns, from docs/ARCHITECTURE.md section 4. Nothing produces one of these in Phase 1. It is defined now so ChecklistItem.grader_result_id has a real referent and the contract is fixed before any grader exists to bend it.

verdict.description: insufficient_evidence is a first-class verdict, not an error. The failure mode this system is designed against is a grader answering fluently when it should say it cannot tell.

confidence.description: The grader's own estimate, calibrated downstream. Never compared against a hardcoded threshold.

evidence_used.description: Which evidence, and which regions of it, the verdict relied on. A verdict that used no evidence is not a verdict.

observed_value.description: What was actually read or measured, so a reviewer can check the grader rather than re-checking the photo.

expected_value.description: From the requirement's pass_criteria, resolved at grading time.

explanation.description: One or two sentences for the tech, in plain language. No jargon.

model_version.description: The pinned provider model behind this result, or null for a grader with no model. Model providers change behaviour without notice; this is what lets the eval harness notice.

allOf.$comment: A grader that cannot tell must not also claim to be sure. Capping confidence on insufficient_evidence keeps a confident non-answer from clearing anything once auto-clear exists.

regions.description: Bounding boxes the verdict relied on. Empty means the whole image.
